name: DAMNED
summary: A search for ultralight scalar-dark-matter modulation of materials and fundamental constants by comparing the frequency of the same ultrastable laser at different times.
detection_principle: A long fiber delays earlier light for beating against the current signal; dark-matter changes in cavity length, fiber length or refractive index produce a periodic beat-frequency shift.

status.label: Published experimental record; current overall operating status unverified
status.evidence: 2021 sources support the phase recorded here, rather than a real-time status of the entire project as of the access date.

timeline.event: Searching for dark matter with an unequal delay interferometer

collaboration.name: DAMNED Collaboration / project team
collaboration.participants_note: Only documented principal institutions are listed; full author and affiliation lists are in the sources. Collaborating-institution addresses are not substituted for detector locations.

results.summary: No dark-matter evidence; model-coupling constraints were improved near the optical cavity's mechanical resonance.

science_scope: Directly searches for Galactic-halo axions, axionlike particles or other ultralight dark matter. Limits depend on assumed local density, velocity distribution and coupling models; separate scanned mass intervals do not amount to exclusion of the entire range.
